create_DINOHead: create a DINOHead prediction head with configurable MLP layers and bottleneck dimension for self-supervised learning
build_DINOHead_with_batchnorm: build a DINOHead module with batch normalization enabled in the MLP for improved training stability
run_DINOHead_forward: run the DINOHead forward pass to project normalized features to the output dimension
build_MLP_with_build_mlp: build a multi-layer perceptron with GELU activations and optional batch norm using _build_mlp helper
review_DINOHead_init_weights: review the DINOHead weight initialization using truncated normal distribution with std 0.02
